headline: Merz pledges fuel-price relief as E10 hits €2.286; Russian frigate flares at Danish helo; 10y Treasuries touch 5.025%.

stories.title: Merz announces fuel-price relief — instrument still TBD

facts.text: Chancellor Friedrich Merz (BGA Unternehmertag, Berlin): “Ich bin der Meinung, dass wir handeln müssen” — for many who need a car daily, a Belastungsgrenze is reached (tagesschau).
Exact Instrumentarium not set; gov’t coordinating with Länder; “sehr bald” a proposal (tagesschau ~17:46).
Pump context: Super E10 avg €2.286/L (record); Diesel €2.412/L — a few cents from a record (tagesschau).
Merz: Kartellamt has Missbrauchsaufsicht vs “Preistreiberei,” but that isn’t enough for consumers; rejects Übergewinnsteuer for now — Klingbeil still pushes one (tagesschau).
Reiche (Economy) floats targeted Direktzahlungen for certain groups; SPD’s Zorn wants a fuel price ceiling (MDR).

stories.whyItMatters: First clear chancellery pledge of new Sprit relief amid record pump prices — politics ahead of concrete design.

stories.title: Russian frigate fires flares at Danish helicopter off Gedser

facts.text: Danish Defence (Mon evening): RDAF Fennec on routine photographic monitoring of a Russian frigate in international waters off Gedser; frigate fired two flares; one passed at close range (Euronews/AFP).
Tue: FM Lars Løkke Rasmussen called it “completely unacceptable”; Russia’s ambassador summoned; PM Mette Frederiksen: “reckless action… meant to intimidate and divide” (Euronews).
Ambassador Vladimir Barbin (AFP): blamed Danish “provocative” manoeuvres; Russia will investigate (Euronews).
Defence Min. Jeppe Bruus (TV 2 / AeroTime): crew unhurt, helicopter undamaged; not seeking NATO Article 4 consultations at this point.

stories.whyItMatters: Fresh Baltic close call — distinct from morning’s Lithuania drone — another NATO–Russia friction point in northern waters.

stories.title: Moscow warns Western politicians against train travel to Ukraine

facts.text: SPIEGEL: after weekend drone strike on a passenger train near the Poland border, MFA spokeswoman Maria Zakharova said travellers must “nüchtern” weigh risks — nobody can guarantee their safety.

Context: a nearby diplomatic/YES-conference train carried Boris Johnson, Carl Bildt, Sanna Marin, and Merz adviser Günter Sautter; Ukrzaliznytsia did not rule out the YES Express as the intended target (SPIEGEL).
Zakharova accused Kyiv of using Western VIPs as “human shields” for alleged military convoys (SPIEGEL / Moscow Times).
SPIEGEL: Berlin said Mon that until security can be better assessed, no more Zugreisen by top German politicians to Ukraine.

stories.whyItMatters: Explicit travel intimidation after a border-area rail strike — raises the cost of solidarity visits that have used night trains via Poland.

stories.title: 10-year Treasuries hit ~5.025% — highest since 2007

facts.text: tagesschau (ARD Finanzredaktion ~14:04): 10y US Treasury yield climbed to 5.025% — highest since the 2007 financial-crisis era; >1 pp up since Iran war began late Feb.
SPIEGEL: morning print cited 5.03%; US debt recently topped $40T; Bund 10y to 3.57% (multi-year high; ~2.6% end-Feb).
Drivers: energy-led inflation expectations + Fed hike priced for Wed; EZB already hiked last week (tagesschau).
Knock-on: DE Bauzinsen ~4.25% (10y fix, Barkow) — trending toward ~4.5% (FMH’s Max Herbst via tagesschau).

stories.whyItMatters: Concrete yield levels beyond afternoon’s hike-odds framing — funding costs for governments and mortgages reset higher into Fed week.

stories.title: Anthropic co-founder: AI kill switch may need to be mandatory

facts.text: BBC interview: Anthropic co-founder Jack Clark said a third-party-verifiable “kill switch” to shut off dangerous AI “might” need eventual rules/mandates.
Clark: most labs (incl. Anthropic) already have ways to “pull the plug”; specifics should be part of the larger policy conversation.
Context: US “Kill Switch Act” proposals exist; Trump has rejected extinction-risk framing; UK gov’t recently rejected creating a kill switch (BBC).

stories.whyItMatters: New primary angle beyond afternoon’s capex/safety-slowdown nerves — a lab founder openly floating mandatory shutoff capability.
